integrity: Constructive two-way proof of F1–F5; checked with an independent finite-enumeration verifier. No independent external audit or publication-priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to finite bounded integral commutative residuated chains; general finite posets and infinite carriers are not classified.

title: Frobenius-adjoint expansions of finite residuated chains are subalgebra roundings
